Bad service
Apr 2019 • Family
I have been to the restaurant for my first time, thought it would be a great experience since the restaurant is quite appealing. There are many waiters and waitresses around. We were sitting at the corner of the restaurant. No one really noticed us and served us. We waited for a long time to order. Then, waited another long period for the food. The waiter even forgot our order, so we were missing one of the food. It took 30 mins to actually get the attentions from waiters and then another time to check our order. Anyways, not really recommend for anyone who wants a good service! What a bad experience!

A new kid on the block - bit yuppyish
Oct 2015 • Business
Established in the past one or two years, on a good location, two blocks from the Hilton Hotel, on the corner of streets lined with mature trees. Quite a few outside tables, with large fans to keep you cool in the heat of the day. Menu nothing special, predictable international and Asian standards. Tries to cater for the young Hanoi new-rich. Of which there are many. Don't expect a traditional vietnamese experience. Good place to observe how the up & coming Hanoi generation spends their time. And their money.
